name: Kade
description: Atmosphere first. Seasonal menus, your story, and a clear route to a table.

business.name: kade.
business.eyebrow: A LITTLE SLOWER. A LITTLE CLOSER.
business.headline:
Good food.
Better company.
business.intro: A neighbourhood table for long lunches, late conversations and whatever the season brings.
business.story: The best evenings rarely need a plan. Just a warm welcome, something good on your plate, and people you want to stay a little longer with.

name: Crumb
description: A bright little home for good coffee, fresh baking and your neighbourhood regulars.

business.name: crumb
business.eyebrow: FRESH OUT OF THE OVEN. EVERY MORNING.
business.headline:
Good mornings
start here.
business.intro: Slow dough. Proper coffee. A little something worth getting out of bed for.
business.story: We believe a neighbourhood runs on good coffee and familiar faces. So we’re up early, folding butter, shaping dough and getting the first pot on. Come as you are.

name: Still
description: A quieter kind of website. Thoughtful rooms, local discoveries and easy booking.

business.name: still.
business.eyebrow: STAY A LITTLE. FEEL A LOT.
business.headline:
Somewhere
to slow down.
business.intro: Thoughtful rooms. Unhurried mornings. A small city stay that feels entirely your own.
business.story: A good stay is about how it makes you feel. Natural textures, quiet corners and a team with time for you. Step out into the city, then come home to a little calm.
